Ari (PM): Quick recap: post-launch metrics show p95 latency +70ms and two customer feature asks (ENH-77 streaming hint, ENH-81 CSV export). Need to pick scope for next 2-week cycle. Options: (A) latency fixes + export, (B) 3 quick UX fixes + streaming hint. Thoughts?
Devon: latency regression looks tied to batching change rolled last week. Could be one-week surface fix + follow-up infra work. If we pick latency, we may have to delay ENH-81.
Kai (Eng): estimate: latency root fix = 7 dev-days, infra followup = 6 dev-days. CSV export = 4 dev-days. We have ~14 dev-days free.
Rosa (Support): CSV export is high-signal from power-users. Streaming hint is lower priority but helps onboarding.
Ari (PM): Decision factors: revenue/retention impact, QA cost, rollout risk. Proposal: Sprint = latency root fix + CSV export + one small bug (B-14 discoverability). That fits capacity.
Devon: ok but we should keep a canary plan. If latency fix risks p50 regressions, schedule a staged rollout and rollback runbook.
Kai (Eng): I'll draft the runbook and metrics dashboard (tracking p50/p95/error-rate). QA Bot: nightly-ci shows integration tests failing at stream ingest occasionally: failure rate 8% (last 5 runs). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/5678
Ari (PM): Action list: 1) Kai owner latency fix + runbook, 2) Devon owner CSV export, 3) Rosa to update customers and collect priority sample, 4) QA to prioritize streaming flakiness tests. Grooming session tomorrow 09:30. Locking scope unless blocker by EOD today. :lock:
Devon: :+1:
Rosa (Support): I'll email top 5 customers and update KB.
Kai (Eng): will create PRs and set up canary config.
QA Bot: created ticket TEST-982 for flaky stream tests.
Ari (PM): Great. We'll reconvene post-groom to finalize acceptance criteria.
